note: RFC 4271 Section 9.1.4 requires installing both the less and more specific accepted routes (or their aggregate) in Loc-RIB when they share the same NEXT_HOP. TestRFC4271OverlappingReceivedRoutesAreBothInstalled feeds 10.0.0.0/8 and 10.0.0.0/24 with NEXT_HOP 10.0.0.1 through handleReceivedStructured and asserts both are installed in Loc-RIB; TestRFC4271OverlappingRouteArrivalDisplacesNeither verifies arrival in either order leaves both installed without withdrawing the earlier route.
